Independent review fixes (M1 atomic not-interested/unsave with exact undo, M2 record and evidence corrections, L1-L5) applied in a fourth commit. summary: Onboarding tour (backend and front-end wiring): a read-only-for-the-person's-data demo project (pdh-demo) served from a throw-away offline SQLite sandbox built from a built-in fixture (29 public arXiv Transformer-lineage papers: 5 unrated candidates + 24 earlier records spread over four weeks, with categories, pinned-term history and pre-written zh/en previews); request routing by header X-PDH-Demo or project_id with an allow list and a 403 demo_readonly for everything else; /api/onboarding (state, start, done) with state in onboarding.json; /api/projects carries a demo descriptor; app_version.current(); first-run assertions in the packaged-backend verifier. Front end: tour.js/tour.css wired into the main, settings, weekly and creation pages; api() sends the demo header only while the demo is current; the demo id is never stored; demo mode hides every entry that would fetch, call a model, read a PDF or edit; settings 'replay tour'; creation page offers 'see the demo' when there is no project. Later in the same unit: a bilingual welcome card (w0) before the tour chooses interface language and appearance (saved with merge so other settings survive; the demo sandbox is built after the save so it follows the language); the daily button no longer names a number; not interested / too hard show a pressed state on cards and in the detail pane, are undone by pressing again (/api/undo by record id; /api/feedback retract), and survive a reload (cards carry feedback, feedback_id, familiarity; every feedback write returns the stored state). Review fixes: not interested removes a saved paper from the library inside the same transaction and undo restores it exactly; the creation page drops a stale c1 hint once a project exists; a take-back that the server turned into a re-confirmation is reported as such; a main page opened while the stored step belongs to another page offers Continue / Skip tour; a demo 403 only suppresses the same request's duplicate toast; the demo hides category editing and labels paraphrased abstracts in the library detail, and the tour no longer promises pinning.
scope_note: Worktree onboarding-tour: every non-merge commit after 7fe946d except the update-check ones (aecdac5, 38e8b1e, cb1623a, e5f01c6, abf692b) plus the fourth commit (review fixes). The update-check files are covered by that branch's own record.

budget_impact.rationale: The demo triage writes pre-written previews (model=demo); no provider is called, no prompt registered, no retry. The sandbox gateway cannot call a model even with DEEPSEEK_API_KEY set.
budget_impact.after: demo with zero tokens and no network

open_risks: The organization worker lock is global: a demo graph job and a real organization job exclude each other (the loser gets 'already running').
A request that sends X-PDH-Demo gets the sandbox for every non-settings route; the page must send the header only while the tour is on screen.
Windows cannot delete an open sandbox file; the old generation then stays until the next reset (tested by simulating a failed delete, not on Windows).
Direction names in the sandbox library are written in the language chosen at reset time; switching the interface language mid-tour does not rename them.
sessionStorage survival across page loads in WKWebView / WebView2 is an inference.
Selector dependence: tour steps target ids/classes in index.html, settings.html, organization.js and profile-ui.js; a renamed element degrades to a centred bubble after 15 s rather than blocking.

Browser-verified in the preview pane on 2026-10-24 (welcome card, English dark walk to the end, Chinese light to r2, skip saves, marks, review fixes M1/L3); not verified: the late tour steps (f1-f7) a second time after the feedback-mark change, frozen binary, Windows, WKWebView/WebView2 sessionStorage across pages.

Not interested on a saved paper takes it out of the project's library in the same commit as the label (what was removed is kept under the label's id in the settings table); undoing that label puts it back with its original save time and note. No confirmation dialog.
